meaning:
εἰρηνεύω
(εἰρήνη), [in LXX chiefly for שׁלם, שׁקט ;]
1. to bring to peace, reconcile (so 1Ma.6:60).
2. to keep peace, be at peace: Mrk.9:50, Rom.12:18, 2Co.13:11, 1Th.5:13 (cf. Sir.28:9; Cremer, 246).
† (AS)
